headline: Ring's first smart lock includes hand crank for dead batteries
summary: Amazon-owned Ring is launching its first smart lock, which includes a built-in hand crank that can generate power to unlock the door if its batteries die.

claims.statement: Ring is launching its first smart lock, featuring a hand crank to generate power when batteries die.

sources.quote: Ring is entering the smart lock market with a device designed to tackle a common concern: getting locked out when the battery dies.
Ring's smart lock has a built-in hand crank to generate power when the batteries are dead.
